name: Impersonation, Vishing and Smishing
description: Fraudsters pose as banks, police, tax authorities or delivery firms by phone, SMS or email, harvesting credentials or inducing customers to move money. The criminal often spoofs numbers and uses urgency and fear.

sources.text: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (specify year, e.g. 2025)
FCA, consumer warnings on impersonation fraud (general)

exposure.rationale: Victims contacted by phone, SMS or email and induced to share codes or move money; card details used at new merchants and wallets.

indicators.name: Customer reports unsolicited call or text from 'the bank'
indicators.canon: Customer reports unsolicited call or text from 'the bank'
indicators.desc: contact claims to be from the bank's fraud team and requests action, codes or transfers.
indicators.ctx: Victim-side: contact claims to be from the bank's fraud team and requests action, codes or transfers.
refs: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (published annually)

indicators.name: One-time passcode shared or requested during a call
indicators.canon: One-time passcode shared or requested during a call
indicators.desc: authentication codes are read out or entered while the customer is on a live call.
indicators.ctx: Victim-side: authentication codes are read out or entered while the customer is on a live call.
refs: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (published annually)

indicators.name: Login from new device shortly after phishing click
indicators.canon: Login from unfamiliar device, location or infrastructure
indicators.desc: Session originates from a device, country, emulator or network not previously associated with the customer, including shortly after a phishing event.
indicators.ctx: Attacker-side: credentials harvested via a fake site are used on an unfamiliar device or location.
refs: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (published annually)

indicators.name: Spoofed phone number matching the bank's real number
indicators.canon: Spoofed phone number matching the bank's real number
indicators.desc: Outbound spoofing makes calls appear genuine; call-detail records reveal the discrepancy.
indicators.ctx: Outbound spoofing makes calls appear genuine; call-detail records reveal the discrepancy.
refs: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (published annually)

indicators.name: Mass of near-identical SMS or links referencing parcels or fines
indicators.canon: Mass of near-identical SMS or links referencing parcels or fines
indicators.desc: Bank brand impersonation campaigns observed in threat feeds and customer reports.
indicators.ctx: Bank brand impersonation campaigns observed in threat feeds and customer reports.
refs: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (published annually)

indicators.name: Customer instructed to move money to a 'safe' account
indicators.canon: Customer instructed to move money to a 'safe' account
indicators.desc: Victim-side: pretext of protection leads to transfers to unfamiliar accounts.
indicators.ctx: Victim-side: pretext of protection leads to transfers to unfamiliar accounts.
refs: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (published annually)

indicators.name: Mule accounts receiving phished funds then cashing out
indicators.canon: Account receiving funds from multiple apparent fraud victims
indicators.desc: A new or low-activity account receives payments from several unrelated individuals who appear to be victims of fraud or phishing, followed by onward movement or cash-out.
indicators.ctx: Receiving accounts withdraw cash or buy crypto promptly after credits.
refs: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (published annually)

indicators.name: Payment card details used at new merchants immediately after a call
indicators.canon: Payment card details used at new merchants immediately after a call
indicators.desc: Victim-side: card details given verbally are used for online purchases or wallet provisioning.
indicators.ctx: Victim-side: card details given verbally are used for online purchases or wallet provisioning.
refs: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (published annually)

indicators.name: Spike in digital wallet provisioning on one customer card
indicators.canon: Spike in digital wallet provisioning on one customer card
indicators.desc: Attacker provisions the card to multiple wallets after obtaining one-time codes.
indicators.ctx: Attacker provisions the card to multiple wallets after obtaining one-time codes.
refs: UK Finance, Annual Fraud Report (published annually)
